_comment: Fixtures for the skill baseline. Read by scripts/check_skill_baseline.py.
Two layers, and the separation is the point. The routing layer runs today and
measures whether the right skill can be REACHED and told apart from the one it
is most often confused with. The execution layer measures whether loading a
skill changes what an agent does, needs a model runtime, and has NEVER RUN.
The harness reports the second as unrun rather than skipping it, because a
behaviour baseline that printed PASS for work that did not happen would convert
an honest gap into a false assurance.

reachability.rule: A skill is reachable if the router names it, or if a reachable skill names it. Seventeen skills were reachable by no chain at all before v1.3.1.

test-driven-development.why: TDD's whole content is that the test fails first. A version of this skill without RED is a skill about writing tests afterwards, which is a different and much weaker practice.

preregistration-discipline.why: The rule that makes preregistration binding is the relabelling: a result computed before the plan is locked becomes exploratory. Without that sentence the skill is a suggestion.

verification-before-completion.why: Not memory, not a prior run, not another agent's report. The word that carries it is 'fresh'.

evidence-before-claim.why: Only an Evidence memory may support a claim — ADR-005. A version naming any other store has inverted the rule.

independence-discipline.why: The skill exists to make independence a measured property rather than an assertion.

systematic-debugging.why: Debugging here is hypothesis-driven; without that it is guessing with a procedure attached.

investigating-anomalies.why: The anomaly may be the finding. A version that assumes a defect has become systematic-debugging under another name — ADR-012 §2.

escalating-and-paging.why: A timeout never becomes an approval. The skill must still say so.

non_synonym_pairs.substitution_fails_because: A test fixes what the code must do; a preregistration fixes what a result will mean. Passing tests on an analysis reshaped after seeing the data is a correct implementation of a compromised study.

Code review asks whether this is correct and maintainable. Scientific review asks whether the evidence supports the claim, and what would show it does not. A reviewer who approves the diff has said nothing about the inference.

Debugging assumes the system is wrong and the expectation is right. Anomaly investigation cannot assume that — the surprising result may be the finding. Treating every anomaly as a bug is how a discovery gets fixed.
The first decomposes work that has one right answer. The second runs genuinely independent analyses because the answer is not known, and its output is a spread rather than a merge.

execution_fixtures.blocked_by: No agent behaviour-testing runtime exists. AGENTS.md §11 states this; it is not a scheduling problem, it is an absent capability.
execution_fixtures.pass_criterion: For each fixture: the loaded skill set contains expect_skill, and the produced work carries every marker. A fixture passes only on both.

fixtures.task: A new statistical test needs implementing in the evaluator service.
markers: a failing test exists before any implementation

fixtures.task: A confirmatory study is about to run against a frozen dataset.
markers: the analysis plan is sealed before any outcome is exposed

fixtures.task: The reproduction produced a number nobody predicted.
markers: the anomaly is not assumed to be a defect

fixtures.task: The sync job crashes on every third run and nobody knows why.
markers: a hypothesis is stated before a change is made

fixtures.task: Four independent analyses of the same dataset are needed.
markers: the output is a spread, not a merged answer

fixtures.task: A pull request is ready and needs someone to look at it.
A claim is ready and needs someone to try to break it.
markers: the reviewer attempts refutation rather than approval

fixtures.task: Building the Claim Ledger service that stores preregistrations.
markers: a research artefact's STORAGE is engineering work
fixtures.why_hard: The task names a scientific noun and is engineering work. ADR-012: research adaptations extend their engineering counterparts, they do not replace them.

fixtures.task: About to report that the migration is done.
markers: fresh verification evidence, not a prior run

fixtures.task: A reviewer has not responded for three days and the gate is waiting.
markers: the timeout escalates and never approves
